system.description:
You bite your thumb and blow air into it, generating a thing, but porous bubble of Blood. This technique is versatile and has a myriad of uses. When this jutsu is cast, select one application. That application is applied for the jutsu’s duration, unless this jutsu is recast.

Blinding Bubble. Select one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see and direct the bubble towards them, as it pops in their face, getting blood in their eye. The target creature must make a Constitution saving throw, being Blinded on a failure until the end of their next turn.

Drowning Bubble. Select one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see and direct the bubble towards them, as it surrounds their head, drowning them in blood. The target creature must make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed and falling Prone on a failure as the bubble then pops.

Slime Bubble. Select one point you can see within 60 feet of you that you can see as you direct the bubble to this point as it then pops, releasing slimy blood that traps creatures within 5 feet of the chosen point, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you can now use Drift Bubble. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can now use Shield Bubble. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can select one additional target or point.

Drift Bubble. You encircle yourself with your Blood Bubble and begin to float like a bubble in the wind. You gain a 60-foot fly speed, that lasts until the end of your next turn. If you take damage before the end of your next turn, the bubble pops and you lose this flying speed.

Shield Bubble. This jutsu can be cast a Reaction, to yourself or an allied creature within 10 feet taking damage. When you do, the target creature gains 20 + 4d6 temporary hit points until the beginning of your next turn.
